abort.already_configured: This access token is already configured.

error.insufficient_scope: This token works, but it was not issued with the `inventory:read` scope. Issue a new one with at least `inventory:read`, plus `shopping:read` and `shopping:write` for the shopping list and `budget:read` for the spend sensor.
error.invalid_auth: The instance refused this access token. It may have been revoked or have expired, or the account that issued it may have left the household.
error.invalid_token_format: A Chaudron access token starts with `chdr_`. This looks like something else.
error.invalid_url: Enter the full address of your Chaudron instance, including `https://`.
